items.headline: xAI releases Grok 4 Fast
items.summary: Grok 4 Fast is a cost-efficient model that combines reasoning and non-reasoning modes with a 2M-token context window, priced from $0.20/$0.50 per million input/output tokens and available to free Grok users. xAI claims performance comparable to Grok 4 while using about 40% fewer thinking tokens.
